Postdoctoral Researcher in Quantum Computing

Offer Description

The Department of Physics at ETH Zurich invites applications for a postdoctoral position in quantum computing. The successful candidate will work on developing novel quantum algorithms for optimization problems. Contact: prof.mueller@ethz.ch or jobs@ethz.ch for enquiries.
